changes: Added a non-runtime artifact release provenance ledger at .lattice/artifact-releases.jsonl, read-only artifact_release_list/status commands, DONE post-merge recording, command policy/catalog wiring, docs, and validate smoke coverage. The ledger records docs/** and experiments/** provenance without broadening CLI semver bumps.
usage: Run `lattice artifact_release_list --format=json --limit=20` to inspect recent artifact release records, or `lattice artifact_release_status --storyId=B-xxxx --format=text` to inspect one story. DONE emits `artifact release recorded` when non-runtime releasable paths are merged.
expectedOutcome: A user can inspect non-runtime DONE artifact provenance independently from CLI package semver. Empty ledgers return [] or a clear no-records message; simulated docs/experiments DONE paths produce deterministic sha256 artifact-set provenance.
actualTranscript: `artifact_release_list --format=json --limit=3` returned []; `artifact_release_status --storyId=B-none --format=text` returned `No artifact release records found for B-none`; artifact-release-ledger smoke passed 8 assertions including dirty already-recorded retry durability.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible mismatch. The live ledger is empty in this worktree, as expected before a DONE merge records an artifact release; the smoke proves the DONE-like recording path.
limitations: The ledger is provenance only. It does not activate a package release, does not publish remotely, and does not broaden CLI patch semver rules. Live records appear only after future DONE merges with releasable non-runtime paths.
pitfalls: Review found a real high bug: already_recorded could skip committing an uncommitted ledger row after a failed/interrupted commit. Commit b70d2738 fixed this by force-adding and committing dirty already-recorded ledgers, with smoke coverage. Scope also required explicit acknowledgements for command-policy/config/process-fact files and ProofStory intent artifacts.
